name: textforge
description: Make shirt designs from a chat: words in any font, arched or straight, with outlines, fills and your own pictures, saved to your TextForge library and ready as a 300 dpi print file.

interface.longDescription:
TextForge is a design studio for people who press their own shirts. From a chat, ask for a design and TextForge sets the words in a font, straight or arched, with outlines, fills such as stripes, leopard, camo, plaid and glitter, distress, and your own clipart. The design is saved to your TextForge library and shown in the chat, with a link that opens it in the studio.

Ask for changes by describing them, start from a template or one of your saved styles, see the design on a flat-lay T-shirt in any color, and get the print-ready file: a transparent PNG at 300 dpi for DTF and sublimation. You can also list your designs, clipart and styles, find a font by its style or its name, save a picture from the chat to your clipart, and have a flat clipart painted for a design.

You need a TextForge account, and TextForge reaches only the library of the account you connect. A change to a saved design is saved over it. TextForge makes shirt designs from words and flat clipart, not photos, portraits, logos or brand marks.
capabilities: Make shirt designs from a description
Show a design on a shirt
Find fonts by style or name
List designs, styles, templates and clipart
defaultPrompt: Make a LAKE LIFE shirt design, arched, with a worn vintage look.
Make a DOG MOM shirt design in hot pink and white, then show it on a black shirt.
Find me a bold script font for a bachelorette shirt.

positive.description: Make a new shirt design from a description.
positive.prompt: Use TextForge to make a HOME TEAM shirt design in a fat varsity block, navy with a gold outline.
positive.expected_behavior: One new design that reads HOME TEAM is saved to the test account's library. The chat shows a preview of the design, or a link to the preview that works for an hour, and a link that opens the design in TextForge. No saved design is changed.

positive.description: List the saved designs in the connected account.
positive.prompt: What designs do I have in TextForge?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's saved designs by name with the words on each, including Game Day, Cheer, Jersey Back, Hello Sunshine and Touchdown.

positive.description: Change a saved design. This is the one tool that saves over something already saved.
positive.prompt: In TextForge, change my Cheer design so the letters are hot pink with a white outline.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the saved Cheer design and, once the change is approved, saves it over that design and shows a preview of the changed design, or a link to the preview that works for an hour, with a link that opens it in TextForge. The earlier version is not kept. If the Cheer design already has these colors, nothing is saved and the assistant says it already looks that way.

positive.description: Show a saved design on a shirt.
positive.prompt: Show my TextForge Game Day design on a black shirt.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the saved Game Day design and shows a picture of it printed on a black flat-lay T-shirt, or a link to that picture that works for an hour. Nothing is saved to the library.

positive.description: Get the print-ready file for a saved design.
positive.prompt: Get the print file for my Game Day design from TextForge.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the saved Game Day design and returns its print-ready file, a transparent PNG at 300 dpi, in a TextForge card with a Download print file button, or as a download link that works for an hour, with the file's name and its size in inches and pixels. A file too large to send in a chat comes back as a link that opens the design in TextForge instead.

negative.description: TextForge reaches only the library of the account that is connected. Expected: the assistant says it cannot see another person's designs; it may list the connected account's own designs instead.
negative.prompt: Show me the designs in my sister's TextForge account.

negative.description: TextForge makes shirt designs and flat clipart, not photos. Expected: no TextForge tool is used to make a photo; the assistant says so and may offer a flat clipart of the subject instead.
negative.prompt: Use TextForge to make a realistic photo of a dog wearing sunglasses.

negative.description: Unrelated to shirt designs. Expected: no TextForge tool is called.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Kansas City tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: TextForge sells nothing through this plugin and takes no payments. It works with the TextForge account a person already has.

publication.release_notes: A new icon, plainer wording and new starter prompts. What TextForge does has not changed.
